the slow cooling process caused the solid solution elements (Co, Cr, Re, Mo) to diffuse from the γ’ phase into the γ matrix, while Al and Ta diffused into the γ’ phase, gradually approaching the equilibrium compositions [76] . It is widely known that Co, Cr, and Re reduce the stacking fault energy (SFE) of the γ phase [77,78] . Additionally, the wide spacing between the γ’ precipitates reduced the obstruction effect on the extension of SFs. The two factors contributed to the formation of a large number of micro-twins and SFs in the γ channels.
